text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—'I'm gonna make this an amazing debut!' 
Just like I promised, I ran with every bit 
of strength I had! What a huge relief!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Makin' the fans happy through my runnin' 
really is the best feelin' after all."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
“Right now, the only reason people find me 
interesting is because I'm from the 
countryside. I realized all over again 
that I need to build real strength while 
this hype lasts.”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's why I'm gonna take on the 
Triple Tiara route! My first goal is the 
Hanshin JF! I'm gonna do my best together 
with Trainer, no siree!"
